title: SC-ARENA: A NATURAL LANGUAGE BENCHMARK FOR SINGLE-CELL REASONING WITH KNOWLEDGE-AUGMENTED EVALUATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the biological reasoning and knowledge discovery capabilities of Large Language Models in the context of single-cell biology. It contains an Ethics Statement regarding data usage and the reliability of LLM-as-a-judge, but does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
